$comment: Platform preference for the review operation's seats (see scripts/lib/review-seat-settings.mjs). parallelSeats on|off: every juror seat of a review-pr run starts at once instead of one after another (tool override env WE_REVIEW_PARALLEL_SEATS). seatsByTouchSet on|off: the review daemon picks the seat list from the PR's touch-set before the run starts, so an all-prose PR (e.g. backlog cards only) does not seat the security juror; code PRs keep both mandatory seats (tool override env WE_REVIEW_SEATS_BY_TOUCH_SET). speculativeRedTeam on|off (scripts/lib/review-speculative-red-team.mjs): the review job starts the post-accept red team beside the juror seats and keeps it only on accept; deliberately NOT set here, so the platform preference (review.speculativeRedTeam in scripts/lib/delivery-platform-preferences.json) or the standard default (on) applies; set it here only to override for this repo (env WE_REVIEW_SPECULATIVE_RED_TEAM beats both). shadowSeats.antigravity.model names the agy model for the SHADOW mandatory seats only (advisory, never counted; trial of Gemini 4 Argon from 2026-10-13); absent = the routing policy's model; on an Argon failure the seat re-runs loudly on the routing policy's model; env WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_MODEL beats it. shadowSeats.antigravity.trialReviews is the trial length in completed shadow reviews (one review-pr run where that model returned a usable answer), not days (operator 2026-10-13); the report node scripts/lib/agy-shadow-trial-report.mjs shows N of that count and says trial complete when reached; reaching it never promotes anything (env WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_TRIAL_REVIEWS beats it). unattendedAcceptRequiresCleanReferrals (boolean, default true; env WE_REVIEW_UNATTENDED_ACCEPT_REQUIRES_CLEAN_REFERRALS) allows accept or prevention-outstanding after filing, with no open mandatory referrals on the live head; prevention-outstanding also requires every broken finding to be ruled card or not-real; changes is accepted only through the round-cards rule (cards 5471/5470), after its card is filed, under the same live-head and live-referral gate; resolves standard → platform review → this tool file → env, logging through policy-cascade. carryAcrossRebase on|off carries a trusted verdict across identical whitespace-sensitive net patches through the sanctioned restamp writer (WE_REVIEW_CARRY_ACROSS_REBASE). humanSurfaceUsesNetDiff (boolean, standard true): human-surface-repark judges the pinned head against its merge-base with freshly fetched origin/main; unavailable net basis skips a complete clean GitHub files list, otherwise re-parks fail closed with a fixed public reason. Raw git diagnostics stay in local logs. Set false only to restore the GitHub files-list decision. Platform review.humanSurfaceUsesNetDiff is inherited unless overridden here; env WE_REVIEW_HUMAN_SURFACE_USES_NET_DIFF beats both. Operator 2026-10-16: shadowSeats.antigravity.enabled defaults false (WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_ENABLED). When enabled with scope sampled, sampleRate defaults 0.1 (WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_SAMPLE_RATE), deterministic SHA-256 of repo#pr; allowed 0 <= rate < 1, 1 is refused with a logged warning. Off shows agy shadow off (setting), never a quota hold. minNonClaudeSeats defaults 1 (WE_REVIEW_MIN_NON_CLAUDE_SEATS), a positive integer: add Codex advisory seats to meet it and report any unavailable/failed-seat shortfall in the write-up. scope defaults high-care: elevated/high earned shape or existing sensitive escalation reasons; sampled restores sampleRate (WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_SCOPE). dailyCap defaults 100 seat attempts per America/New_York day (WE_REVIEW_SHADOW_AGY_DAILY_CAP); atomic reservations beside the agreement log count starts, including retries. Cap skips and quota holds never retry on the routing model. These leaves resolve standard → platform → tool → env with source logging. autoRoundGrant.cardOnly (scripts/conveyor/auto-round-grant.mjs; operator 2026-10-19 standing ruling, confirmed 2026-10-20 "automate, capped at 3 per PR"): enabled true|false turns on the automatic +1 review round for a PR whose net diff vs main is only backlog/** at its round cap (standard off); it also needs the operator's recorded standing ruling (an open issue the operator authored, scripts/conveyor/standing-ruling-mark.mjs), whose bounds always win; maxPerPr can only lower the per-PR cap (standard 3, never above 3 or the ruling's); repos lists the owner/repo slugs it applies to (standard web-everything/web-everything). humanDeescalateEnabled (boolean, standard true; kill switch env WE_REVIEW_HUMAN_DEESCALATE=off), humanDeescalateKinds (array, a subset of the kinds with a clearing proof: round-cap, referral-pending, referral-malformed, referral-ledger-sync-failed; any other entry refuses the layer; env WE_REVIEW_HUMAN_DEESCALATE_KINDS comma list) and humanDeescalateInferLegacy (boolean, standard false: a pre-marker park comment cannot prove it explains an add; env WE_REVIEW_HUMAN_DEESCALATE_INFER_LEGACY) drive scripts/conveyor/human-escalation-deescalate.mjs: the review daemon lifts an escalation-added review:human once its recorded cause is cleared and the net diff needs no human; hand-added and rule-required review:human is never lifted; any unreadable input keeps it. Resolves standard -> platform -> this file -> env with source logging.
